Commentary.Commentary: It will require a good batting display from the Kiwis to hunt down this competitive target on this double paced track. Can they achieve it or will the South Africans go on to lead the series 2-1? Join us in a while for the chase.

Colin de Grandhomme was the pick of the bowlers and he kept the batsmen at bay by registering his career best figures of 10-0-40-2. Santner also kept the run flow in check and Boult was effective with the ball too.

AB de Villiers came out to bat and started off slowly with Duminy at the other end. He kept losing partners from the other end but kept on ticking the scoreboard. With another half century under his belt, AB de Villiers also became the fastest player to reach 9000 ODI runs. Parnell gave him good support in the end by playing a handy knock of 35 runs to help the Proteas cross the 270-run mark.

A brilliant end by the Proteas has helped them post a good total on the board. Quinton de Kock gave them the perfect start as he managed to score his 5th 50 plus score in consecutive ODI matches. Faf du Plessis came in after Hashim Amla who struggled in the middle and could not last long. Faf got off to a good start and played nicely but failed to capitalize on it. Colin de Grandhomme struck twice in the 23rd over to send both the settled top order batsmen back in the pavilion.

OUT! Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Parnell slogs it to deep mid-wicket and the batsmen come across for a quick single. Parnell turns back for the second but the throw from Santner is an accurate one to the striker's end. Parnell sprints into get back as Latham flicks the bails off. Is he in? Time for the replays. They show that his bat was in the air and that costs them a run. South Africa finish on 271/8.
There is a run out appeal against Parnell which is being checked upstairs.
FOUR! Just over the infield! Parnell comes down the track and takes it on the full. Just clears the man at mid off and the ball rolls across to the fence.
Low full toss on leg stump, Andile drills it to long on for a single.
Yorker around off, hit through mid off for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo walks out to bat.

OUT! AB de Villiers departs after a brilliant knock! Low full toss outside off, de Villiers bends low and hits it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. Has hit that well but hasn't got enough elevation on it. Jimmy Neesham in the deep judges it well and leaps to take a very good catch. New Zealand will be happy to see the back of him.
FOUR! Terrific shot! Full length delivery outside off, de Villiers crouches and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Yorker length ball outside off, de Villiers squeezes it to mid off for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, de Villiers steers it to third man for a couple.
Low full toss outside off, de Villers drags it to long on and gets two runs for it.
FOUR! Shot! Fractionally overpitched outside off, de Villiers backs away and smashes it over mid off and earns himself another boundary.
Wide! Short delivery well outside off, de Villers was winding up for a big shot down the ground but resists.
Slower and fullish delivery at 97 clicks on middle and leg, Parnell works it through square leg and gets a run for it.
Very full delivery outside off, de Villiers backs away and looks to force it through the off side but gets an inside edge past his stumps and towards short fine leg. A run taken!

Angled into the pads, de Villiers clips it towards the fielder at square leg and rushes for a single. The fielder has a shy at the stumps. A direct hit on the stumps on the striker's end would have been close.
Short and wide outside off, de Villiers shuffles across and plays a tennis ball pull but straight to the fielder at square leg.
Full toss outside off, Parnell guides it towards the fielder at third man for a single.
Short outside off, AB de Villiers pulls it towards long on for a single.
Yorker on the stumps, De Villiers digs it out as he gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a couple.
FOUR! INNOVATIVE! Full toss on the pads, AB shuffles across and sit down to play a sweep shot through the square leg region for a boundary. The perfect platform for the assassin.
A low full toss outside off, de Villiers crouches and places it nicely to third man for a single. 11 off that over!
Fullish delivery, hit hard to long off for a run.

Run out chance missed! Fullish delivery outside off, Parnell drives it to Broom at extra cover. De Villiers is backing up too much and Broom throws it at the bowler's end. Misses and AB surives. De Villiers was a goner.
Low full toss outside off, Parnell makes room and goes inside out. The deep cover fielder cuts it off. Parnell gets a couple for it.
Bangs a short delivery around off, AB pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
50-run partnership between AB de Villiers and Wayne Parnell.
SIX! Amazing shot! Good length delivery outside off, de Villiers drives it hard over covers. Gets good elevation on it and the ball sails over the fence,

Fullish delivery, Parnell works it through backward square leg and takes a single. AB calls him through for the second run and Parnell sprints in. The throw from the fielder hits Parnell on the helmet. Seems to be alright, could have been nasty.
Length delivery outside off, de Villers carves it over covers for a run.
Almost a yorker length ball around off, de Villers looks to drive it but gets an inside edge to mid on.
Comes over the wicket and digs in a short ball in line of the stumps, pulled nicely to deep square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, de Villiers hits it hard to extra cover. Single taken!
Short of a length ball outside off, shaping in and stays low. AB looks to pull it across but misses.
Full toss on the stumps, Parnell stands in his crease and pushes it down the ground towards the long on region for a couple.
de Villiers drives it through covers for a single.
On the pads, Parnell fails to clip it as the ball hits the pads. The ball goes towards the mid-wicket region and they sneak a LEG BYE!
SIX! WIDTH AND PUNISHED! Short and wide outside off, Parnell stays in his crease and slaps it over the cover region for a maximum. That was brute force there.
WIDE! Too high for any batsman as that went over the head. Wide is signalled by the umpire.
Again down the leg side, de Villiers clips it on the leg side for a single.
51st ODI fifty for AB de Villers.

Sprayed on the pads, AB de Villiers clips it through the square leg region. The fielder at the boundary makes a fine effort to save the boundary. The batsmen manage to run a couple as AB de Villiers reaches another half century in his career. Terrific player and he has a bit more than 5 overs still left.
Short of a length delivery around off, tucked through mid-wicket and de Villiers will retain the strike.
Short delivery outside off, cut hard to the fielder at point.
Good running! Parnell stays back to the good length delivery and dabs it to covers for a sharp single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Parnell has a slash at it but fails to make any connection.
FOUR! Good pickings! Fuller length ball angling in, Parnell goes downtown and makes decent connection. Gets it over the man at mid on and earns a boundary for himself.
Southee comes around the wicket and bowls a back of a length delivery in line of the stumps, pushed off the back foot to mid on.
Another change in the attack, Tim Southee will bowl the next over.
Straying on the pads, nudged to the leg side for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

An appeal for caught behind turned down! Good length delivery shaping in sharply, de Villiers is cut into two halves as he looks to play it across but misses and the ball brushes his thigh pad and goes straight into the gloves of Latham. The umpire is not interested in the appeal. There was no bat involved.
FOUR! Pure class! Fullish delivery outside off, de Villers creams it through covers and the ball whistles away to the fence.

FOUR! Whacked! Bangs in a short delivery on middle and leg, AB stands tall and pulls it hard through square leg. He has hit that with supreme power and the dive in the deep by the fielder is to no avail.
Ferguson has been bowling brilliantly today! Runs in hard and bowls an indipping full toss on middle, AB is surprised a touch but manages to block it out to mid-wicket.
Well bowled! Tosses it  nicely outside off, spinning away. Parnell waits for it and looks to play it behind point but gets beaten. Good spell by Santner comes to an end. He has figures of 10-0-45-1.
Shorter delivery outside off, de Villers cuts it through point for a run.
Tossed up outside off, Parnell gets into position early and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Loopy delivery, de Villiers sweeps it nicely to deep backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery, Parnell lofts it over the bowler's head for a single.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, AB makes room and drives it through covers for a single.
Mitchell Santner is back for his final over.
Short of a length ball outside off, cut hard to point where it is well stopped by Broom.
Short delivery on middle and leg, de Villiers pulls it hard to fine leg for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, placed behind point for a single.
Length delivery angling in, Parnell stays back and defends.

In the air... but safe! Back of a length delivery angling away from Parnell. He looks to force it through the on side but gets a leading edge that falls safely in the cover-point region and rolls through. Couple taken!
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single
The umpire has signalled for Powerplay 3. Now five fielders are allowed outside the 30 yard circle.
Good length delivery outside off, Parnell stays in his crease and pushes the ball towards the fielder at point.
Back of a length delivery in the line of the stumps, Parnell stays back and pushes it back to the bowler. Boult dives towards his left to make a fine stop.
Good length delivery nipping in, Parnell tries to clip it on the leg side but the batsman finds a leading edge towards the fielder at covers.
Angling into the stumps, Wayne Parnell prods forward and defends it.
The batsman has driven it towards mid on.
Length delivery outside off, the batsman drives it through covers for a single.
Trent Boult is back for a bowl.
Fuller length ball on off, Parnell drives it through mid off and gets a couple for doing so. Great over by Parnell. A wicket and three runs from it.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Wayne Parnell replaces Dwaine Pretorius in the middle.

OUT! Bowled 'em! A perfect follow delivery to fox Pretorius and he had no answer to that one. Ferguson hurls in a yorker length ball around off at 140.2 clicks, Dwaine was not expecting that. Stays back and looks to place it square through the off side but misses it completely. The ball disturbs the off stump and off go the bails. Ferguson is elated. The South African innings has lost its way.
This is good bowling by Ferguson. Bangs in a short delivery outside off, Pretorius looks to run it down to third man but misses.
Fuller length ball around off, de Villers drives it through covers for a single.
Fullish delivery on off, AB strides forward and defends it.
Lockie Ferguson is back for a bowl.
Tossed up outside off, driven with the spin to sweeper cover for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Beautifully bowled! Tosses it up on off, coming in with the arm. Pretorius comes forward tentatively and gets an inside edge towards square leg. Single taken!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker one on middle, clipped against the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball on off, driven to mid off.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single
FOUR! Crafty shot! Pretorius stays deep in the crease to the good length delivery outside off and guides it past the keeper for a boundary.
Short of a length ball outside off, Dwaine stays back and taps it to covers.
Back of a length delivery outside off, de Villers dabs it behind point for a single.
Wide! Dug in short around middle and off, shoots off the pitch once more. AB ducks under it.
Short of a length ball outside off, this one zips through the pitch. De Villiers goes for a cut but fails to make anu contact.
Driven through the covers by the batsman
Loopy ball on middle, defended to mid-wicket. A wicket and 4 runs from that over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! Short delivery outside off, Dwaine cuts it nicely through point and gets s boundary to his name.
Dwaine Pretorius is the next man in.

OUT! Miller fails to make a mark! Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Miller clips it uppishly towards short mid-wicket. Neil Broom who is stationed there is alert, crouches and seems to be have taken a good low catch. The Kiwis are confident and are already celebrating. But the umpires walk across and consult whether it has been taken cleanly or not. The replays indicate that Broom has got his hands underneath the ball. The TV umpire decides that the replays are conclusive enough and the soft signal stays. Good passage of play for the Kiwis!
The umpires have gone upstairs to check for a catch taken by Broom at short mid-wicket. The soft signal is out. Miller is the man in question.
Bowls it on a flatter trajectory outside off, Miller camps back and plays it towards point.
Miller comes down the track and clips the quicker delivery to mid-wicket.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Short of a length delivery outside off, guided to third man for a single.
The batsman plays the pull shot. They pick up a single.
Southee bangs in a good bouncer around off, de Villiers has to sway away from the line to evade it.
Shortish delivery outside off, steered to third man for a single.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Tim Southee is recalled for a bowl.
Tossed up delivery, pushed to mid on from the front foot.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up on off, Miller eases it through mid on for a single and gets off the mark.
Quicker one outside off, punched nicely to sweeper cover for a single.
David Miller walks out to the crease.

OUT! Brilliant effort from Southee sends Duminy packing! Tossed up outside off, going away with the arm. Duminy dabs it towards point and sets off for a run. That's a risky call and he has to sprint towards the other end. Southee rushes in towards the ball, picks it up nicely and hurls in a quick throw at the non-striker's end. Duminy is struggling as the ball hits the timber. The run out appeal is taken upstairs. Time for the replays. They show that Duminy is well short of his crease. Timely wicket for the Blackcaps.
A run out appeal against Duminy has been referred upstairs.
Santner darts this one on middle and leg, de Villers clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Time for Drinks.
Short and outside off, AB de Villiers steers it past the point region for a single.
Way wide outside off, de Villiers lets it through as he thinks it is a wide. The umpire decides to not give it a wide.
Fuller outside off, Duminy reaches to it and drives it down the ground towards long off for a single.
Short delivery on the pads, Duminy works it around towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Duminy plays it to point where it is well stopped by the fielder.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Duminy gets out his broom and sweeps it towards square leg for a single.

MISSED OPPORTUNITY! Quicker delivery fired outside off, Duminy dances down the track and tries to reach it but he fails to make contact. The keeper is unable to gather it as it is too wide for him as well and that helps Duminy come back in the crease.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Tossed up on the pads, de Villiers tries to clip it on the leg side but he misses it. The ball hits him on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire is not interested as it was surely going down leg.
Tossed up and Duminy sweeps it on the leg side for a single.
Duminy camps back and defends the ball.
LEG BYE! Down the leg side, Duminy tries to clip it but he misses. The ball hits him low on the pads and tickles away towards the fine leg region for a single.
Wide outside off, Duminy goes to reach it but he cannot find the contact.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SAFE AND LUCKY! Outside off on a length, Duminy gets an bottom edge over the stumps.
Duminy stays deep in his crease to defend it.
FOUR! LUCKY! Good length delivery outside off, Duminy tries top defend it but he is beaten by the inward movement as he gets an inside edge past the keeper towards fine leg for a boundary.
Trent Boult is called back for a bowl.
Tossed up outside off, AB de Villiers drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
On the pads, Duminy clips it fine down the leg side for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Floated on the pads, de Villiers sweeps it through the square leg region. The fielder from fine leg cuts it off and saves the boundary. The batsmen manage to pick up a couple.
Short into the stumps, Duminy pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Fuller delivery outside off and de Villiers gets to the line of the delivery and drives it through covers for a single. A brilliant spell from Colin de Grandhomme comes to an end as he ends with a spell of 10-0-40-2.
Length delivery outside off, de Villiers cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
On a good length outside off, Duminy punches it through covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery into the pads, Duminy shuffles a bit and goes for a pull but misses. The ball hits him high on the pads.
Good length delivery angling across off, Duminy pushes it straight to the fielder at mid on.
In the line of the stumps, Duminy uses his crease to defend it.
Floated up in the line of the stumps, de Villiers gets it through the inner half of the bat towards long on for a single.
Floated up just outside off, Duminy scoops it fine on the leg side to get a single.
Wide outside off, AB de Villiers stays deep in his crease and punches it through the cover region for a single.
Short into the stumps, de Villiers pushes it again back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, Duminy cuts it through the cover region for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Duminy camps back and pushes it back to the bowler.
On the pads, Duminy clips it through the mid-wicket region to keep strike with a single.
A bit short this time as Duminy punches it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery outside off, Duminy cuts it late but straight to the fielder at point.
Duminy stays in his crease and defends it towards the fielder at point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Down the leg side, AB de Villiers clips it on the leg side for a single.
De Villiers punches it through the cover region for a single.

NOT OUT! Down the leg side, AB de Villiers tries to clip it down the leg side but misses as the keeper collects it. The players appeal in unison for a caught behind but the umpire says no. Kane Williamson is quick to opt for a review. The replays show that there was no contact between the bat and the ball on its way to the keeper and that means the on-field decision is upheld.
New Zealand have taken a review against AB de Villiers for a caught behind.
Outside off, de Villiers cuts it through the cover region for a couple.
Flighted up in the line of the stumps, AB de Villiers dances down the track and tries to flick it on the leg side but misses.
Floated up, AB de Villiers leans forward and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, Duminy plays a predetermined sweep to get a single through the leg side.
Mitchell Santner is back into the attack.
FOUR! SMOKED! Fuller delivery outside off, AB de Villiers dances down the track and smacks it through the cover region for a boundary. Terrific shot!
Down the leg side, Duminy clips it on the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Duminy stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at point.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
De Villiers prods forward and defends it.
Beautiful outswinger from a length outside off, de Villiers goes to play at it but misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Short delivery into the body, de Villiers pulls that through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. With that shot he surpasses Sourav Ganguly to become the fastest player to reach 9000 ODI runs.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. They pick up a single.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short delivery into the body, de Villiers stands tall and defends it on the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. This can prove to be a game changing over. Two wickets and two runs from it.
WIDE! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
JP Duminy strides out to bat.

OUT! QdK DEPARTS! Short delivery on middle and leg, de Kock stays in his crease and goes for a pull. He connects well but has hit it flat towards deep mid-wicket. Neesham rushes to his left and takes a fine catch. The beautiful innings from the South African southpaw comes to an end. New Zealand have clawed back into the contest, pressure on the two new batsmen at the crease.
On the pads, AB de Villiers clips it through the leg side for a single.
De Villiers stays behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
AB de Villiers walks out to bat.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Fuller delivery outside off, du Plessis drives it uppishly to the fielder at mid off. Southee does not make a mistake there as he moves towards his left and takes a fine low catch. Du Plessis has to walk back to the pavilion after getting a good start.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Almost chopped that back! Shortish delivery in line of the stumps, de Kock comes down the track to play at it but gets a bottom edge which goes over the stumps towards the keeper. That missed by a whisker!
WIDE! Down the leg side, de Kock goes for a glance but it is too far. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Good length delivery outside off, de Kock goes for a push to the delivery outside off and misses.
Angling into the pads, Quinton goes to clip it on the leg side but misses. The ball hits him on the thigh pad.

SIX! Just on the ropes! Angling into the stumps, de Kock stays in his crease and whacks it through the square leg region. The fielder at deep mid-wicket runs to his left and tries to reach it with a dive but the ball was too far from him. The ball hits the ropes for a maximum.
Du Plessis drives this one through the cover region for a single.
Length delivery outside off, du Plessis drives it straight to the fielder at covers.

Shout for LBW! Good length delivery which pitches on the leg stump line and angles in a bit, de Kock goes to clip it but misses. The ball hits him on the pads and the players appeal. It looked close to the naked eye but replays show that there was an inside edge.
Good length delivery outside off, du Plessis pushes it through covers for a single.
On the pads, Quinton shuffles across and goes for a pull but he gets an inside edge towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, de Kock shuffles across and gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Length delivery in the line of the stumps, QdK stays in his crease and defends it.
Down the leg side, Faf clips it square on the leg side for a single.
Short into the body, Faf sways away a bit and somehow manages to guide it towards the fielder at third man for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Faf drives it straight to the fielder at extra cover.
Down the leg side, Quinton works it fine down the leg side for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, de Kock stays deep in his crease and defends it towards covers.
Full toss on the pads, Quinton clips it through the mid-wicket region. The batsmen pick up two runs in the process.
Short delivery into the body, Faf is no where in control of the shot as he pulls it towards the square leg region for a single.
Good length delivery outside, Faf pushes it through covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Faf works it fine towards third man. The fielder slips there and they manage to pick up a couple.
On the pads, de Kock works it down the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery just outside off, de Kock tries to defend it but gets an outside edge which tickles away towards the fielder at point.
Quinton stays deep in his crease and defends it.
FOUR! Top shot! Wide outside off, QDK slaps it through the point region to get another boundary under his belt.
Down the leg side, de Kock clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, de Kock stays back to defend it.
Full delivery outside off, du Plessis guides it towards the fielder at third man for a single.
WIDE! Short delivery into the body, du Plessis sways away from the line of the delivery as it is too short and wide.
Good length delivery outside off, du Plessis goes for a drive but misses it completely.
Angling into the stumps, Faf pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
Dug in short and sliding across off, QDK stays tall and pulls it towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a single.
Lockie Ferguson comes back into the attack.
Drinks has been taken.
Fullish delivery on the pads, clipped uppishly through mid-wicket for a single and Quinton will retain the strike.
Short of a length ball outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover. Single taken!
Tom Latham walks up to the stumps to keep wickets to Colin de Grandhomme.
Du Plessis comes down the track to the fullish delivery and lofts it over mid on. Has enough time to come back for the second.
That's a peach of a delivery! On a driving length outside off, Faf shapes to drive it through covers but the ball nips away to zip past his outside edge.
12th ODI fifty for Quinton de Kock.

Straying on the hips, de Kock clips it nicely through backward square leg and gets a run for it. Back-to-back half centuries for de Kock. It has been a free flowing knock from this special player. He needs to carry on.
Good length delivery around off, de Kock shuffles and looks to tuck it square on the leg side but misses and is struck on the thigh pad.
Tossed up outside off, de Kock picks up the length early and slog sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated up in the line of the stumps, de Kock prods forward in defence.
Tossed up outside off, du Plessis reaches the pitch of the delivery and drives it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Width given outside off, du Plessis stays in his crease and cuts this one late past the point region. The fielder gives it a chase but the ball wins the race. Faf is rewarded with a boundary.
Fuller on the stumps, Faf stays in his crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
On the pads, de Kock clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish delivery curving back in line of the stumps, du Plessis strides forward and keeps it out. Good over by Colin, only one from it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short of a length delivery around off, du Plessis stays back and plays it to point.
Fullish delivery, clipped to mid-wicket.
Short delivery on middle, pulled to mid-wicket where the fielder makes a half-stop. Single taken!

Confusion that could have cost a run out! Back of a length delivery outside off, de Kock taps it towards point and sets off for a run. Faf initially calls him through but almost sells him down the river. Sends de Kock back as the fielder comes charging towards the ball. He hurls in an underhand flick towards the striker's end but misses. Had he hit, it would have been close.
Slow through the air and in line of the stumps, eased down to long on for a single. Good batting by de Kock and Faf, they are keeping on ticking the scoreboard.
Loopy ball around off, Faf strides forward and eases it to long off for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, nudged to mid-wicket for a run.
On a good length on middle, Faf stays back and works it against the spin to mid-wicket. Single taken!
Tossed up on off, pushed off the front foot back towards the bowler.
Fullish on middle and leg, nudged round the corner for an easy single.
Time for spin. Mitchell Santner to roll his arm over.
Angling into the pads, de Kock works it down the leg side to keep strike with a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side, de Kock tries to clip it but that was far down the leg side. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Back of a length delivery outside off, du Plessis camps back and cuts it past the fielder at point for a single.
Length ball outside off, Faf pushes it towards point.
Outside off on a good length, left alone.
Huge shout for LBW! Angling in from a good length into the pads, du Plessis goes for a flick but misses. He gets hit on his pads and everyone appeal in unison. The umpire says no.

Good length delivery just outside off which nips in a bit after pitching, Faf goes to defend it but he manages to find an edge which goes towards the third man fielder. The fielder at third man slips and Faf calls for a double. Quinton who was ball watching reacts late and they manage to complete the runs.
Back of a length delivery outside off, angling in. Faf stays back and punches it to mid off for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! What a shot! Faf is a pleasure to watch when in full flow. Stands tall to the shortish delivery outside off and flat bats it over covers for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Lucky runs! Shortish delivery well outside off, Faf looks to cut it away but gets an outside edge over the slip region and the ball rolls through to the third man fence.
Short of a length outside off, du Plessis camps back and pushes it to the off side.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Delightful! Overpitched outside off, Faf strides forward and creams it through covers for a delightful boundary.

Well bowled by Grandhomme. In the last game, he had opened up Faf and beaten him to rattle his stumps. Seams this one back in a similar way from outside off, Faf is tentative with his foot movement but manages to block it out.
In the channel outside off, moves away after pitching. Faf doesn't fiddle with that one.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
On a length in line of the stumps, tucked to the on side for a single.
Powerplay 2 signalled by the umpire. Four fielders will be allowed now outside the 30-yard circle. Colin de Grandhomme is also called in for a bowl.
Fullish delivery, Faf covers the line and pushes it to mid on.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
SIX! That's a screamer! Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, de Kock whips it away with utmost ease and sends it sailing way over the deep square leg fence.
Back of a length delivery around middle and leg, Quinton looks to tuck it  away but gloves it towards the on side.
Oh! That was quick! Ferguson hurls in a full length delivery on leg stump at 149 clicks, de Kock looks to clip it but is rapped on the pads.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lockie Ferguson comes into the attack.
On a length on off, Faf comes forward and defends it nicely.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Faf du Plessis strides out to bat.

OUT! Amla's struggle comes to an end! He was looking jittery out in the middle and Southee sends him back. Bowls a length ball around the leg stump, Amla is not well balanced as he looks to clip it across. Gets early into his shot and spoons out a leading edge towards Williamson at mid off. The Kiwi skipper makes no mistake and pouches it safely.
A play and a miss! Fuller length ball well outside off, Hashim with minimal foot movement throws his bat at it but makes no connection whatsoever.
Short of a length ball around off, defended off the back foot by Amla.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven through extra cover for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.

Amla gets lucky this time! Goes for an expansive drive to a fuller length ball outside off with minimal foot movement. Gets a thick inside edge past his leg stump and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, whipped away by de Kock to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Comes around the wicket and angles in a back of a length ball outside off, Amla looks to force it through the off side but ends up playing it from the outer half behind point. Single taken!
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Shortish delivery and room on offer, de Kock looks to upper cut but fails to make any contact.
FOUR! That's whacked! Shorter length ball around off, de Kock swivels across and nails the pull through square leg and the ball races to the fence.
On a length in line of the stumps, nudged towards in front of square. De Kock wants the single but is sent back by Amla.
Back of a length ball well outside off, Quinton goes for a cut but misses.
FOUR! Shot! Quinton comes down the track to the fuller length ball outside off and drives it towards Williamson at mid off. He gets a bad bounce and the ball runs through and to the long off fence.

Big appeal for caught behind turned down! Short delivery going down the leg side, de Kock looks to hook it but seems to have missed it as the ball goes straight into the hands of the keeper. The Kiwis go up in an appeal straightaway but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show that there was no wood involved there.
Back of a length delivery, Amla stays back and defends it from the inner half to the leg side.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Good fielding, Southee! Bowls a shortish delivery on middle and leg, Amla pulls it nicely through square leg. Southee in the deep races across to his left and puts in a slide to keep the ball in play. Hurls in an accurate throw to the keeper. The umpires check whether it's a boundary or not but Southee is fine.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery around the ribcage area, Hashim is cramped for room and tucks it to mid-wicket.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Southee is unlucky on this occasion. Bowls a very full delivery outside off, de Kock looks to carve it away square through the off side but gets an outside edge. The ball flies right through the first slip and the keeper and goes through to the fence.
Back of a length delivery on leg stump, Amla rises up on his toes and helps it through square leg. Single taken!
Short of a length outside off, seaming away after pithing. Amla leaves it alone watchfully.
On a driving length around off, Amla goes for the drive but mistimes it to covers.
That's a well-directed bouncer by Southee. Bangs it in around off, Amla has to sway away from the line of the delivery to evade it.
Dug in short on midde, de Kock stands tall and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball around off, Amla camps back and defends it to the off side. Good over by Boult.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Fullish delivery on off, de Kock strides forward and defends it back to Boult.
Good length delivery around off, swiniging away. De Kock camps back and feels for it but gets beaten.
FOUR! Delightful! Fractionally overpitched outside off, de Kock strides forward and drives it exquistely through covers and the ball whistles away to the boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The groundsmen are putting sand near the bowler's landing area. Amla had slipped in the previous over while taking a run, so they are ensuring that there are no more slip ups.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, de Kock drives it to mid on and takes a sharp single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Fullish delivery on the pads, de Kock clips it to short fine leg and Hashim calls him through for a run. Good call and they complete the run easily.
Fuller length delivery swinging back into de Kock. He stays back and defends it nicely to mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Back of a length delivery well outside off, steered nicely to third man for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, de Kock cuts it past the fielder at point for a single and retains the strike.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, clipped nicely through square leg for a couple.
Fullish delivery around off, driven to mid off.
Full length delivery shaping back in, de Kock leans ahead and pushes it gently to Boult.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
Straying on the pads, tucked through backward square leg for a run to get off the mark.
Trent Boult to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Fuller length ball slanting across de Kock. He goes for a drive down the ground but gets an outside edge past Taylor at first slip and earns the first boundary for himself.
Southee hurls this one in at a driving length on middle and off, generates some good inswing.  Quinton prods forward and drives it back to Southee who makes a good stop in his followthrough.
Good length delivery angling away from Quinton. He camps back and defends it solidly off the back foot.
First runs of the day! Full delivery and straighter on this occasion, de Kock clips it beautifully through mid-wicket and gets a couple of runs to get off the mark.
Fullish delivery around off, Quinton defends it from the inner half of his bat towards the bowler.
Southee starts off with a fuller length ball around off, de Kock strides forward and defends it down the track.
The players and the umpires have come out in the middle. HASHIM AMLA and QUINTON DE KOCK to open the batting for South Africa. TIM SOUTHEE to start off with the new ball. Here we go...
SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT. One change for the Proteas as KAGISO RABADA comes back in place of Chris Morris. A change for the Kiwis as well as Ish Sodhi makes way for LOCKIE FERGUSON.

Hello and a warm welcome for the 3rd ODI between New Zealand and South Africa at the Westpac stadium in Wellington. The 5-match ODI series is setup nicely now with the hosts bouncing back in the previous encounter at Christchurch. It again went right down to the wire just like the first game and it promises to be a closely fought battle in Wellington as both sides will be raring to take the crucial 2-1 lead. It was Ross Taylor who paved the way for the home side with a terrific century and mixed caution with aggression to perfection. Let's see if the visitors are able to fightback here but it won't be easy against a Kiwi side who have found their confidence back.
